newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Austrian shares consolidate before futures expiry.
newsitem.headline: Austrian shares consolidate before futures expiry.

text.p: Austrian shares eased on Tuesday in consolidation after yesterday's fiesty rally and traders predicted Friday's expiry of futures contracts would weigh on the market over the next few days.
"A small correction is not bad for the market," one trader said. Volumes were thin and buying mainly in selective shares, according to dealers.
The ATX index of 21 blue chips edged 0.31 percent lower to 1,163.83 points. Eight ATX shares rose, 11 fell and two were unchanged.
Traders said ATX could drop to 1,160 points when January contracts expire.
The top gainer was index heavyweight insurer EA-Generali, climbing 1.42 percent to 3,210 schillings.
Micro chip maker AMS led the decliners, losing 3.01 percent to 938 schillings.
Creditanstalt preferred and ordinary shares both ended off, with preferred down 14.1 schillings at 481.9 and ordinary down 1.6 at 725.
The January ATX future shed 1.2 points to 1,162.3.
The broad-based Vienna bourse index dropped 0.58 points or 0.13 percent to 435.82.
